title: Israeli Drone Strike on Vehicle Kills Two in Tal al-Hawa, Gaza City
detail: An Israeli drone struck a civilian vehicle in the Tal al-Hawa neighborhood of western Gaza City on September 13, 2026, killing two people and wounding 13 others. Footage showed the vehicle mangled and gutted, its roof and doors torn away. The IDF said it targeted two Hamas engineers without providing further details; medical staff said the victims' bodies were too dismembered to identify and appealed to the public for information.

media.caption: Aftermath of Israeli drone strike on a vehicle in Tal al-Hawa, Gaza City, Sep 13, 2026
